title.narrative: Regulatory Strengthening and Capacity Building Project

description.narrative: Senegal Power Compact - Regulatory Strengthening and Capacity Building Project: The project will work to strengthen laws, policies and regulations governing the power sector as well as the institutions responsible for implementing them to support long-term economic progress.

title.narrative: Senegal II Compact Key Performance Indicators

condition.narrative: Before the initial Disbursement of Program Funding for the Reform Project, the Government shall develop and adopt a plan to incorporate the ECOWAS Gender and Energy mainstreaming policy during the Compact Term.

Before the initial Disbursement of Program Funding for the Reform Project, the Government shall take steps to support Senelec�s ongoing orientation as a commercial entity, including by completing the accounting unbundling of Senelec in a manner consistent with the Roadmap, including ensuring the resolution of any related and outstanding audit findings.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
